descriptions.zh: 我们收到了来源不明的读数。这些信号似乎遵循着某种重复的句法，证明其来源应为智慧生物。我们应进一步研究它。它们似乎集中在一个空间站附近，但尚不清楚这个空间站是不是一个更大的太空文明的一部分。
descriptions.en: We have picked up readings of unknown nature. The signals seem to follow some kind of repeating syntax which could indicate sapient origin. It should be investigated further. They seem to be concentrated around a single space station, though it is unclear whether this forms part of a larger spacefaring civilization.

descriptions.zh: 我们探测到了性质不明的读数。这些信号似乎遵循某种重复的句法，这可能表明其源自智慧生命。我们应对此进行进一步调查。信号似乎集中在一艘大型舰船周围，但目前尚不清楚这是否属于某个更庞大的星际文明的一部分。
descriptions.en: We have picked up readings of unknown nature. The signals seem to follow some kind of repeating syntax which could indicate sapient origin. It should be investigated further. They seem to be concentrated around a single large vessel, though it is unclear whether this forms part of a larger spacefaring civilization.

options.script:
name = first_contact_critters.1.A
set_first_contact_stage = enclave_stage_2

descriptions.zh: 在成功的翻译了他们的语言之后，我们与§H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!的独立空间站建立了通讯。
descriptions.en: After successfully translating their language, we have established communications with the independent space station of the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!.

label.zh: 让我们听听他们想不想说点什么。
label.en: Let's see if they want to talk.

descriptions.zh: 长程扫描仪获取了[This.System.GetName]恒星系中的数据，对其的解析几乎说明它是一个巨大热源。这非常值得研究。
descriptions.en: Long range scanners have picked up readings in the [This.System.GetName] system that could best be described as giant heat blobs. It's worth investigating.

options.script:
name = first_contact_critters.10.A
set_first_contact_stage = tiyanki_stage_2

descriptions.zh:
我们称之为“§Y缇扬奇§!”的太空生物十分温顺。它们可以进入低维度的亚空间，因此可以轻易地在星系之间遨游。

它们以气态巨行星外层常见的气体为食。这不太可能是它们唯一的食物来源，但到目前为止尚未观察到其他的进食方式。

它们不会主动进攻，因此可以安全地无视它们。
descriptions.en:
The spaceborne lifeforms - which we call "§YTiyanki§!" - are docile creatures. Capable of accessing some lower dimension of subspace, they roam from system to system with remarkable ease.

They graze on gases common to the upper layers of many gas giants. It is highly unlikely, to say the least, that this is their only food source, but intake of other nutrients has yet to be observed.

They will not attack unless provoked. They can safely be ignored.

descriptions.zh:
圣者们将那个漂浮在黑暗中的存在称为“§Y缇扬奇§!”。他们是神圣而酷爱和平的太空生命体，从一个恒星系漫步到另一个恒星系，依靠众多气态巨行星上表面的常见气体进食，几乎不会有任何表现敌意的情况。

我们应该与其保持距离，以示敬意。
descriptions.en:
The Diviners name the beings, floating through the dark, "§YTiyanki§!." They are a sacred and peaceful spaceborne life form that roams from system to system, feeding on gases common to the upper layers of many gas giants, and rarely showing any signs of hostility.

We are to keep at a respectful distance.

descriptions.zh:
[Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]的社会学研究领袖称之为§H缇扬奇§!”的太空生物十分温顺。它们可以进入低维度的亚空间，因此可以轻易地在星系之间遨游。

它们以气态巨行星外层常见的气体为食。这不太可能是它们唯一的食物来源，但到目前为止尚未观察到其他的进食方式。

它们不会主动进攻，因此可以安全地无视它们。
descriptions.en:
The spaceborne lifeforms - which the [Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] Head of Society Research has come to refer to as "§HTiyanki§!" - are docile creatures. Capable of accessing some lower dimension of subspace, they roam from system to system with remarkable ease.

They graze on gases common to the upper layers of many gas giants. It is highly unlikely, to say the least, that this is their only food source, but intake of other nutrients has yet to be observed.

They will rarely, if ever, attack, even when provoked. They can safely be ignored.

descriptions.zh: 值得注意的是，每个§H缇扬奇§!群体都以母系等级制度为中心，由一头雌兽领导。雌性优先享用所有食物资源，以便为幼崽生产气态母体物质，并引导群体迁徙。因此，雄兽在资源匮乏时会放弃进食，鼓励它们在群体休息时寻找更多食物。
descriptions.en: Of note, there is a matriarchal hierarchy at the center of each §HTiyanki§! pod, with a singular cow leading the group at any one time. Females are given priority to all food resources, allowing them to produce maternal gasses for their young and direct the pod's migrations. As such, bulls will forgo nourishment whenever resources are scarce, encouraging them to scout for more food while the pod rests.

label.zh: 捕猎他们也捞不到什么好处。
label.en: Hunting them would be a net loss anyway.

descriptions.zh:
当我们进入[This.System.GetName]时，传感器获取了一个奇怪的数据。一开始把它们当成发光的小行星而忽视了，但后来当发现它们会对太空中的移动物体哪怕距离很远都会做出一定的进攻性反应，事情就变得有趣了起来。

建议最好从安全的距离上观察这些东西。
descriptions.en:
Upon entering [This.System.GetName] our sensors picked up strange readings. Dismissed at first as glorified asteroids, things quickly changed when it was discovered that these entities reacted aggressively to movement in space - even at great distance!

Observation of these entities - preferably from a safe distance - is advised.

label.zh: 最好从远处观察，继续吧。
label.en: Best viewed from afar. Keep it up.

options.script:
name = first_contact_critters.20.A
set_first_contact_stage = amoeba_stage_2

descriptions.zh:
我们的舰队不久前遇见的存在是一种全新的、美丽的、神奇的太空生命。

因为分析员对传感器数据的误读，这种生物很快就获得了“太空变形虫”的昵称，它们的体积比一般的[Root.Owner.GetAdj]护卫舰更巨大。

我们应该避免与它们接触，从[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]远距离观察这些生物。
descriptions.en:
The entities encountered by our fleets some time ago are new, wondrous, forms of spaceborne life.

Quickly nicknamed "Space Amoeba" following an analyst's gross misreading of initial sensor output, the creature is in fact larger than the average [Root.Owner.GetAdj] corvette.

We should leave it be and remotely monitor the creature and its kin from [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName].

descriptions.zh:
我们的舰队不久前遇见的存在是一种全新的、骇人的太空生命。

因为分析员对传感器数据的误读，这种生物很快就获得了“太空变形虫”的昵称，它们的体积比一般的[Root.Owner.GetAdj]护卫舰更巨大。

终结这些憎恶异形苟活于世的苦难应该没有什么害处。

既是为了科学，也可以是为了其他什么。
descriptions.en:
The entities encountered by our fleets some time ago are new, horrifying lifeforms.

Quickly nicknamed "Space Amoeba" following an analyst's gross misreading of initial sensor output, the creature is in fact larger than the average [Root.Owner.GetAdj] corvette.

There would be little harm in putting the monstrosities out of their misery.

For science, or some equivalent.

descriptions.zh:
我们的舰队不久前遇见的存在是一种太空生命。

因为分析员对传感器数据的误读，这种生物很快就获得了“太空变形虫”的昵称，它们的体积比一般的[Root.Owner.GetAdj]护卫舰更巨大。

这些生物对[Root.Owner.GetAdj]舰船表现出了敌意的行为，但我们授权进一步的研究。
descriptions.en:
The entities encountered by our fleets some time ago are spaceborne forms of life.

Quickly nicknamed "Space Amoeba" following a tactician's gross misreading of initial sensor output, the creature is in fact larger than the average [Root.Owner.GetAdj] corvette.

The creature displays aggressive behavior towards [Root.Owner.GetAdj] ships but further study might be warranted.

descriptions.zh:
我们的舰队不久前遭遇的是一种从未见过的太空生命。

因为分析员对传感器数据的误读，这种生物很快就获得了“太空变形虫”的昵称，它们的体积比一般的[Root.Owner.GetAdj]护卫舰更巨大。

虽然它脾气很坏，但是想进一步研究也不是不行的——我们可以从[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]远距离观察它们。
descriptions.en:
The entities encountered by our fleets some time ago are new, spaceborne lifeforms.

Quickly nicknamed "Space Amoeba" following an analyst's gross misreading of initial sensor output, the creature is in fact larger than the average [Root.Owner.GetAdj] corvette.

Despite its apparent orneriness, further study is warranted - we can remotely monitor the creature and its kin from [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName].

descriptions.zh:
我们的舰队不久前遇见的存在是一种全新的太空生命。

尽管个体体型远远大于[Root.Owner.GetAdj]的护卫舰，这些“太空变形虫”兽群相对于我们的舰队依然弱小不堪。
descriptions.en:
The entities encountered by our fleets some time ago are new, spaceborne lifeforms.

While significantly larger than a [Root.Owner.GetAdj] Corvette, these "Space Amoeba" herds are minuscule next to our full corpus.

descriptions.zh:
我们的舰队此前遭遇到的实体是一种新发现的太空生命形式。

由于最初对传感器数据的粗略误读，我们很快就给它们起昵称为§H“太空变形虫”§!，实际上这种生物比[Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]护卫舰的平均尺寸还要大。
descriptions.en:
The entities encountered by our fleets some time ago are new, spaceborne lifeforms.

Quickly nicknamed §H"Space Amoeba"§! following a gross misreading of initial sensor output, the creature is in fact larger than the average [Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] corvette.

descriptions.zh: 若得以安抚，它们可以成为我们种荚的理想携带者。
descriptions.en: If pacified, they could prove themselves ideal carriers for our Seed Pods.

descriptions.zh: 除了最年轻的个体外，其他所有个体都伴随有通过RNA掺杂分泌物控制的准独立生物体。这些“鞭毛”以复杂的攻击模式进行攻击，因此尽管它们看似缺乏智慧，但§H“太空变形虫”§!却是非常熟练的自然捕食者。
descriptions.en: All but the youngest specimens are accompanied by quasi-independent organisms controlled via RNA-laced secretions. These "flagella" strike in complex attack patterns, so despite their apparent lack of sapience, §H"Space Amoeba"§! are highly adept natural predators.

tooltips.zh: 每消灭一支太空变形虫舰队可获得§G+1000§!£energy£
tooltips.en: §G+1000§! £energy£ for every Space Amoeba fleet destroyed

label.zh: 研究或许可以加速将来的消灭行动。
label.en: A study may expedite future extermination.

descriptions.zh: 我们之前用§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!指称的不规则物体看起来一定程度上由晶态物质组成。有趣的是，它们可以在虚空中推进，并能在必要的时候保护自己，说明他们应该是具有生命的。我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]正在做进一步的调查。
descriptions.en: The irregularity we had designated as §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! appears to be made of some sort of crystalline material. Curiously, it seems to be able to propel itself across the void and protect itself when necessary, indicating that it may be alive. Our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] are working hard to find out more.

options.script:
name = first_contact_critters.30.A
set_first_contact_stage = crystals_stage_2

descriptions.zh:
我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]已经完成了对这种在[This.System.GetName]恒星系发现的非凡的、自由漂浮的晶态物体的调查报告。他们的发现令人震惊。

这些飞船般大小的物体以及它们的较小型的晶体卫星初看之下是无生命迹象的，然而一旦我们飞船靠近，它们就会突然改变方向并且从晶体内散发出能源波动，这说明它们也许是以生命形式存在的——这样的现象毫无疑问令人好奇，但我们得要小心处理。

我们最杰出且聪敏的科学家们都准备好研究这些实体了。
descriptions.en:
Our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] have finished investigating the reports of extraordinary, free-floating crystal-like objects observed in the [This.System.GetName] system. Their findings are startling.

The ship-size objects and their slightly smaller but equally crystal-like satellites at first appeared inert, but sudden shifts in their orientation relative to our ships and new energy signatures emerging from within the prisms indicate that they might be alive - a fascinating prospect to be sure, but they should be approached with caution.

Our best and brightest are standing by to study these entities.

descriptions.zh:
我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]已经完成了对这种在[This.System.GetName]恒星系发现的非凡的、自由漂浮的晶态物体的调查报告。他们的发现令人震惊。

这些飞船般大小的物体以及它们的较小型的晶体卫星初看之下是无生命迹象的，然而一旦我们飞船靠近，它们就会突然改变方向并且从晶体内散发出能源波动，毫无疑问它们具有可能的危险性，我们应该小心应对。

我们最好派遣一支舰队试探这些晶体的侵略性，如果发现有威胁就把它们摧毁掉。
descriptions.en:
Our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] have finished investigating the reports of extraordinary, free-floating crystal-like objects observed in the [This.System.GetName] system. Their findings are startling.

The ship-size objects and their slightly smaller but equally crystal-like satellites at first appeared inert, but sudden shifts in their orientation relative to our ships and new energy signatures emerging from within the prisms indicate that they should be regarded as hazardous and approached with extreme caution.

We should deploy a fleet to gauge the crystals' offensive strength, should they possess any, and destroy them if they are a threat.

哪怕找不到什么战斗用途，我们研究一个被击碎的晶体肯定也会有一些有趣的发现。

Even should we not find a martial use for them, studying a shattered crystal would no doubt yield interesting results.

We should deploy a fleet to gauge the crystals' offensive strength, should they possess any, and destroy them if they are a threat.

我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]已经完成了对这种在[This.System.GetName]恒星系发现的非凡的、自由漂浮的晶态物体的调查报告。他们的发现令人震惊。

这些飞船般大小的物体以及它们的较小型的晶体卫星初看之下是无生命迹象的，然而一旦我们飞船靠近，它们就会突然改变方向并且从晶体内散发出能源波动，毫无疑问它们具有可能的危险性，我们应该小心应对。

哪怕找不到什么战斗用途，我们研究一个被击碎的晶体肯定也会有一些有趣的发现。
descriptions.en:
Our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] have finished investigating the reports of extraordinary, free-floating crystal-like objects observed in the [This.System.GetName] system. Their findings are startling.

The ship-size objects and their slightly smaller but equally crystal-like satellites at first appeared inert, but sudden shifts in their orientation relative to our ships and new energy signatures emerging from within the prisms indicate that they should be regarded as hazardous and approached with caution.

Even should we not find a martial use for them, studying a shattered crystal would no doubt yield interesting results.

descriptions.zh:
我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]已经完成了对这种在[This.System.GetName]恒星系发现的非凡的、自由漂浮的晶态物体的调查报告。他们的发现令人震惊。

这些飞船般大小的物体以及它们的较小型的晶体卫星初看之下是无生命迹象的，然而一旦我们飞船靠近，它们就会突然改变方向并且从晶体内散发出能源波动，它们毫无疑问具有可能的危险性，我们应该小心应对。

既然我们不想冒险得罪这些晶体，那就从首都远距离监视它们吧。
descriptions.en:
Our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] have finished investigating the reports of extraordinary, free-floating crystal-like objects observed in the [This.System.GetName] system. Their findings are startling.

The ship-size objects and their slightly smaller but equally crystal-like satellites at first appeared inert, but sudden shifts in their orientation relative to our ships and new energy signatures emerging from within the prisms indicate that they should be regarded as hazardous and approached with caution.

As we do not wish to risk coming into conflict with these prismatic enigmas, we ought to establish remote surveillance and observe them from the capital.

descriptions.zh:
我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]已经完成了对这种在[This.System.GetName]恒星系发现的非凡的、自由漂浮的晶态物体的调查报告。他们的发现令人震惊。

这些飞船般大小的物体以及它们的较小型的晶体卫星初看之下是无生命迹象的，然而一旦我们飞船靠近，它们就会突然改变方向并且从晶体内散发出能源波动，毫无疑问它们具有可能的危险性，应该小心应对。

我们既可以选择直接与这些危险的生命体交火，也可以从远距离安全地观察它们。
descriptions.en:
Our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] have finished investigating the reports of extraordinary, free-floating crystal-like objects observed in the [This.System.GetName] system. Their findings are startling.

The ship-size objects and their slightly smaller but equally crystal-like satellites at first appeared inert, but sudden shifts in their orientation relative to our ships and new energy signatures emerging from within the prisms indicate that they should be regarded as hazardous and approached with caution.

We can either attempt to engage with the potentially dangerous objects directly, or establish remote surveillance and observe them from a safe distance.

descriptions.zh: 我们不确定这些生物是否进食，只要他们吃东西就可以当做我们种子的携带者。安抚他们可以让我们进行进一步的研究。
descriptions.en: We're unsure these creatures are capable of eating, but if so, they could prove useful carrier for our seeds. Pacifying them would allow us to conduct further studies.

descriptions.zh: 这些生物似乎通过折射光线的色度变化来相互交流。虽然这种媒介具有表达复杂信息的巨大潜力，但这些半智慧生命体只以基本的方式使用它。颜色的变化可以用来表示社会地位、攻击性，甚至生育状况。
descriptions.en: These creatures seem to communicate with one another via chromatic changes in refracted light. While this medium has high potential for complex expressions, it is only utilized in a basic manner by these semi-sentient lifeforms. Changes in color can be used to indicate social status, aggression, and even fertility conditions.

tooltips.zh: 每消灭一支晶态实体舰队可获得§G+500§!£minerals£
tooltips.en: §G+500§! £minerals£ for every Crystalline Entity fleet destroyed

descriptions.zh:
我们在[This.System.GetName]发现了一种新的生命形式，虽然称之为“生命”可能不太准确。这些实体看起来完全是一种完全出于未知的工业用途的全自动无人机器人。

我们会继续观察，但由于这些机器有自我保护的编码，所以最好谨慎行事。
descriptions.en:
We have discovered a new lifeform in [This.System.GetName], although calling it a "lifeform" may be incorrect. The entities appear to be fully automated, mechanical drones built exclusively for some unknown industrial purpose.

Observations will continue, but since it's likely that these machines are programmed with defensive protocols, it would be prudent to tread lightly.

options.script:
name = first_contact_critters.40.A
set_first_contact_stage = drones_stage_2

descriptions.zh:
我们遭遇的深空无人机似乎是自动轨道采矿作业的工人和监工。根据加工设备的状况来判断，这些采矿作业似乎开始于数千年前，然后很快被抛弃，只留下了无人机继续运作。这些无人机拥有强力的采矿激光，并且在我们试图靠近时表现出了明显具有威胁性，甚至是侵略性的举动。

或许它们只是些老旧的无人机，但仍应该密切观察它们。
descriptions.en:
The deep-space drones we have encountered appear to be the workers and custodians of autonomous orbital mining operations. Judging by the state of the processing equipment, these sites were established millennia ago and then soon abandoned by all but the drones themselves. The drones possess powerful mining lasers and make obviously threatening, if not outright hostile, overtures toward us when approached.

They may only be old drones, but they should be kept under close watch.
descriptions.condition: trigger = { owner = { has_ethic = ethic_gestalt_consciousness } }

descriptions.zh:
我们在某个恒星系里发现了深空无人机，这些无人机似乎是千年以前进行自动轨道采矿作业的矿机和监视用机器，但在不久之后采矿行动就被人放弃了，只剩无人机在继续运作。它们的功能很明确——采矿——但是是谁下的命令，目前我们还不得而知，很显然没有任何矿物在百年乃至千年内曾从这个恒星系出口过。

尽管这些可能只是老旧的无人机，但是[Root.Owner.GetName]还是应该注意一下它们。
descriptions.en:
Reports of deep-space drones in certain systems have been investigated. The drones appear to be the workers and custodians of an autonomous orbital mining operation, established millennia ago and then soon abandoned by all but the drones themselves, judging by the state of the processing equipment. Their purpose is obvious enough - mining - but who it is that tasked them is not immediately apparent. What is obvious is that no shipment of minerals has been retrieved from this system in hundreds, if not thousands of years.

They may only be old drones, but they should be kept under close watch by the [Root.Owner.GetName].

descriptions.zh:
我们在某个恒星系里发现了深空无人机。这些无人机似乎是千年以前进行自动轨道采矿作业的矿机和监视用机器，但在不久之后采矿行动就被人放弃了，只剩无人机在继续运作。

这些无人机似乎没有任何通讯协议——至少没有[Root.Owner.GetName]能破译的协议——并对进入了恒星系的[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]飞船采取了攻击行为。

在[Root.System.GetName]发现这种无人机实在是喜人的收获，我们应该进一步研究一下。
descriptions.en:
Reports of deep-space drones in certain systems have been investigated. The drones appear to be the workers and custodians of an autonomous orbital mining operation, established millennia ago and then soon abandoned by all but the drones themselves, judging by the state of the processing equipment.

The drones seem to lack any diplomatic comms protocols - at least any decipherable by the [Root.Owner.GetName] - and react with hostility to [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] ships entering the system.

Their presence in the [Root.System.GetName] system is intriguing, and we should attempt to learn more about them.

descriptions.zh:
我们对关于此前遭遇的深空无人机的报告进行了进一步的调查。这些无人机似乎是数百万年前建造的自动轨道采矿作业的工人和监工。这些采矿作业似乎开始于数千年前，然后很快被抛弃，只留下了无人机继续运作。

这些无人机拥有强力的采矿激光，并且在[Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]舰船试图靠近时表现出了明显具有威胁性，甚至是侵略性的举动。或许它们只是些老旧的无人机，但[Owner.GetName]仍应该密切观察它们。
descriptions.en:
Reports of the deep-space drones previously encountered have been investigated closer. The drones appear to be the workers and custodians of an autonomous orbital mining operation, established millennia ago and then soon abandoned by all but the drones themselves, judging by the state of the processing equipment.

The drones possess powerful mining lasers and make obviously threatening, if not outright hostile, overtures toward [Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] vessels when approached. They may only be old drones, but they should be kept under close watch by the [Owner.GetName].

descriptions.zh:
尽管他们生活在居住站上的事实暗示了他们很可能是一个先进的社会，然而[This.Owner.GetEnvoy][This.Leader.GetName]不能肯定我们是不是真的在和一种智慧生命形式打交道：他们似乎无时不刻在展现敌意，这对于一个稳定的社会而言是不可想象的：即便在我们短暂的调查期间也展现了数次纯粹的野蛮行为。

他们看起来具有语言，但我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]仍在努力解析当中，以便我们在未来能够理解他们的行为。
descriptions.en:
Although their dwellings on habitat stations would suggest an advanced society, [This.Owner.GetEnvoy] [This.Leader.GetName] is unsure whether we are indeed dealing with an intelligent lifeform: they seem unremittingly hostile, so much so that a stable society seems almost unthinkable: even during our brief period of investigation, we have observed several displays of pure barbarism.

They seem to have a language, but our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] are still working on deciphering it so we can make sense of this display.

label.zh: 真令人不舒服。我们可得小心。

options.script:
name = first_contact_critters.50.A
set_first_contact_stage = marauders_stage_2

descriptions.zh:
我们完成了对他们使用语言的破译，[This.Owner.GetEnvoy][This.Leader.GetName]将§H[encountered_marauder.GetName]§!识别为一种游牧文明，称为§H[encountered_marauder.GetRealName]§!。他们在§H[marauder_system.GetName]§!恒星系附近占据了数个大型空间站，其大量的人口都居住在拥挤而肮脏的环境之中。尽管如此，或许正因如此，他们似乎发展出了一种非常尚武的文化。生活在冰冷虚空中成了他们的第二天性，因而高度擅长太空作战。

[encountered_marauder.GetSpeciesName]没有中央政府一说，而是分为数个不同的派系，不断地互相争夺资源与尊严。鉴于其庞大的人口与空间站造船能力，若无永无止境的内斗，他们必将成为严重威胁到全星系和平的势力。
descriptions.en:
Having decoded what counts as a language among them, [This.Owner.GetEnvoy] [This.Leader.GetName] has identified the §H[encountered_marauder.GetName]§! as a nomadic civilization known as the §H[encountered_marauder.GetRealName]§!. They occupy a number of large space stations in and around the §H[marauder_system.GetName]§! system that house the bulk of their massive numbers in crowded and squalid conditions. Despite this, or perhaps because of it, they seem to have developed a strong martial culture. Life in the cold void has become second nature to them, and they are very adept at space warfare.

There is no [encountered_marauder.GetSpeciesName] central government to speak of. Instead, they are divided into several different factions that vie endlessly with one another for resources and respect. Given their large population and the shipbuilding capability of their stations, this constant infighting is the only thing keeping them from growing into a significant threat to galactic peace.

options.script:
name = marauder.1.a
finish_first_contact_effect = yes

descriptions.zh: 我们在[This.System.GetName]遇到的舰船似乎有点过时，但仍然武装到了牙齿。这些舰船应该是有人驾驶的，但对任何靠近的物体都展现了敌意。有必要谨慎应对……
descriptions.en: The vessels we encountered in the [This.System.GetName] system appear to be somewhat outmoded, but nevertheless armed to the teeth. They seem to be piloted by sentient crews but respond with hostility to any approach. We will have to treat them with caution.

options.script:
name = WORRYING
set_first_contact_stage = pirates_stage_2

descriptions.zh:
尽管我们仍然无法与他们建立联络，主要是因为他们并不想理我们，但我们已经可以确认§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!是海盗。视觉指示器表明他们的文化很大程度上是生长于太空的，我们观察到的一些表现形式不符合任何一种居住于行星的文明。

不幸的是，他们的船员似乎对民事交流没有任何兴趣。我们从截获的舰见通讯也表明他们主要以海盗活动为生，偶尔也会招募部分文明边缘的元素到他们的贼船上。
descriptions.en:
Although we have been unable to establish communications with them - mainly because they are unwilling to communicate with us - we have been able to identify the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! as pirates. Visual indicators point to their culture being largely spaceborne, and some phenotypes observed among them match no known planet-dwelling civilizations.

Unfortunately, their crews are completely uninterested in civil discourse. What little we have been able to glean from intercepting intra-fleet communications indicate that they primarily subsist on piracy, occasionally recruiting fringe elements of spacefaring civilizations to their cause.

options.script:
name = pirate.5.a
finish_first_contact_effect = yes

descriptions.zh:
在[This.System.GetName]星系中探测到的舰船似乎正在进行某种横跨星系的远征，这种生活方式对我们自己的族群而言并不陌生。他们没有表现出任何敌意，而是不断向我们方向重复广播信号。

看到一个族群将家园安于星海之间而非任何星球之上，这种景象令人感到几分莫名的亲切。我们的[This.Owner.GetEnvoy][This.Leader.GetName]迫切希望能够进一步了解这些同为旅人的族群。
descriptions.en:
The vessels detected in the [This.System.GetName] system appear to be on some kind of expedition across the galaxy, a way of life our own people know well. They have made no hostile moves, broadcasting repetitive signals in our direction instead.

There is something almost familiar about the sight of a people making their home among the stars rather than on any world. Our [This.Owner.GetEnvoy], [This.Leader.GetName], is eager to learn more about these fellow travelers.

descriptions.zh:
在[This.System.GetName]星系中探测到的舰船似乎正在进行某种横跨星系的远征，这种生活方式对我们自己的族群而言并不陌生。他们没有表现出任何敌意，而是不断向我们方向重复广播信号。

一群流浪者，和我们没什么不一样，但却不太受人欢迎。[This.Owner.GetEnvoy]，[This.Leader.GetName]对此不太感兴趣，但也愿意听听他们要说什么。
descriptions.en:
The vessels detected in the [This.System.GetName] system appear to be on some kind of expedition across the galaxy, a way of life our own people know well. They have made no hostile moves, broadcasting repetitive signals in our direction instead.

Wanderers, not unlike ourselves, though the comparison is an unwelcome one. Our [This.Owner.GetEnvoy], [This.Leader.GetName], is unimpressed, but will hear what they have to say.

descriptions.zh: 在[This.System.GetName]恒星系中侦测到的舰队似乎是某种目的不明的跨星系探险队。他们没有采取任何有敌意的举动，也没有任何显而易见的重型武器，反而他们似乎在反复但无目的地向我们的大致方向广播某种具有实际内容的信号。我们的[This.Owner.GetEnvoy]，[This.Leader.GetName]很困惑，但希望那些广播能帮助我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]翻译他们的语言。
descriptions.en: The vessels detected in the [This.System.GetName] system seem to be part of some sort of expedition across the galaxy, with purposes unknown. They have not made any hostile moves, nor is there any heavy weaponry in evidence - instead, they seem to be broadcasting repetitive but not particularly content-filled signals in our general direction. Our [This.Owner.GetEnvoy], [This.Leader.GetName], is confused, but hopes that the broadcasts will help our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] translate their language.

descriptions.zh: [This.System.GetName]恒星系似乎是某种未知起源的先进社会的家园。居住在恒星系的一系列空间站中，[This.Owner.GetEnvoy][This.Leader.GetName]留意到还有不少飞船在其间穿梭，同时还有一些目的不明的更大的远航舰队离开恒星系。他们似乎在向我们大致方向不断传播着重复的但没有实际内容的信号，这一进展令我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]感到困惑，但这有助于翻译他们的语言。
descriptions.en: The [This.System.GetName] system appears to be home to an advanced society of unknown origins. Dwelling in a series of space stations across the system, [This.Owner.GetEnvoy] [This.Leader.GetName] has observed multiple crafts flitting between them, as well as several larger expeditions leaving the system for unknown purposes. They seem to be broadcasting repetitive but not particularly content-filled signals in our general direction, a development which has confused our [This.Owner.GetLinguists], but may help them to translate their language.

label.zh: 他们已经声明了自己在这片区域的航路吗？
label.en: Have they already claimed this region's Wayline routes?

descriptions.zh: 我们已经成功地破译了§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!向我们发送的令人困惑的重复信息，我们发现这些信息是一些……商业广告！显然他们自称为§H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!，是一个以向偶遇的任何文明提供最优惠的交易谋生的星际商团的一部分，至少他们自称是最优惠的。一如既往，他们似乎正在尝试联系我们。
descriptions.en: We have managed to decipher the confusing, repetitive messages the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! were sending us, and it turns out that they were... commercial advertisements! Apparently they call themselves §H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§! and are part of a group of spacefaring traders that make a living by offering the best deals - or what they claim to be the best deals - to whichever civilization they happen to be visiting at the time. True to form, it appears they are attempting to contact us.

descriptions.zh: 我们已经成功地破译了§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!向我们发送的，一遍又一遍的，令人困惑的信息，我们发现这些信息竟是一些……商业广告！似乎[This.System.GetName]恒星系是一个自称§H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!的星际商团的母星系。显然，他们以向偶遇的任何文明提供最优惠的交易谋生，至少他们自称是最优惠的。
descriptions.en: We have managed to decipher the confusing, repetitive messages the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! were sending us, and it turns out that they were... commercial advertisements! It appears that the [This.System.GetName] system is the home system of a group of spacefaring traders that call themselves the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!. They apparently make a living by offering the best deals - or what they claim to be the best deals - to whichever civilization they happen to be visiting at the time.

tooltips.zh: 当下次他们进入我们边境时我们就可以与行商舰队进行交易了。
tooltips.en: We will now be able to trade with the caravaneer fleets next time they enter our borders.

descriptions.zh: 我们之前用§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!指称的不规则物体可能是一种有机生物，[This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap][This.Leader.GetName]仍在努力验证这一假说。尽管它看起来就是一些随机的星际物质组成的团簇，但毋庸置疑地它们可以在虚空中推进，并展现出了一定程度的自主智能。我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]为这种现象困惑，并正在努力验证获得的数据。
descriptions.en: [This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap] [This.Leader.GetName] is still working to confirm the hypothesis that the irregularity we had designated as §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! is in fact a living organism. While it seems to be made up of a cluster of random star dust, it is demonstrably able to propel itself across the void and shows basic signs of independent agency. Our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] are perplexed by the phenomenon, and are working hard to verify our readings.

options.script:
name = first_contact_critters.80.A
set_first_contact_stage = void_clouds_stage_2

descriptions.zh:
一项对此前以§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!指代的一堆残骸和太空尘埃的调查居然得到了惊人的发现：它是一团由微粒聚集而成的云体，蕴含着来源不明的强大能源。它原本连反射性动作都不应该做出，更不要说是自主移动了。

可它确实在自主移动。

这份录像中移动的飘渺物体透着一股不祥之兆，或许这个宇宙里有一些东西是我们不该去碰的。
descriptions.en:
Our investigation into the peculiar cluster of debris and space-dust with the designation §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! has yielded surprising results: it is a particulate cloud bristling with a powerful charge of unknown origin. It has no business exhibiting simple reflexive actions, let alone movements with purpose.

And yet it does.

There is something undeniably ominous about the hazy subject of the relayed video feeds. Perhaps there are things in the universe we should not tangle with.

descriptions.zh:
“如云，”一份从多个材料整合出来的报道上写着，“如云般的光辉星辰在暗潮中汹涌”。这份报告描述的极具诗意的现象是“虚空之云”。

对于[Root.Owner.GetName]的祭司来说，这些星云是被某种更伟大的意志所驱动的信使，目前没有人知道在背后操控虚空之云的到底是谁或是什么，在确定虚空之云的来龙去脉之前，还是不要轻举妄动为好。
descriptions.en:
"A cloud," reads the awed report, collated from multiple sources. "Like a cloud of luminous star-stuff, billowing in the dark." The report goes on to refer to the phenomenon, somewhat poetically, as a "void cloud."

It is evident to the priesthoods of the [Root.Owner.GetName] that these clouds are heralds animated by some higher will. Exactly who or what this will belongs is the subject of heated debate, and is likely to remain so for the foreseeable future. Until such time as the Void Cloud's true nature can be ascertained, it would perhaps be prudent to treat the immense power evident in its roiling motion with some caution.
descriptions.condition: trigger = { owner = { is_spiritualist = yes } }

descriptions.zh:
一项对此前以§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!为代称的一堆残骸和太空尘埃的调查居然得到了惊人的发现：微粒聚集而成的云体，散发着未知的强大能源，它原本连反射性动作都不应该做出，更不要说是自主移动了。

但它确实在自主地移动着。

这份录像中移动的飘渺物体透着一股不祥之兆，或许这个宇宙里有一些东西是我们不该去碰的。
descriptions.en:
An investigation into a peculiar cluster of debris and space-dust previously dubbed §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! has yielded surprising results; it is a particulate cloud bristling with a powerful charge of unknown origin that has no business exhibiting simple reflexive actions, let alone movements with purpose.

And yet it does.

There is something undeniably ominous about the hazy subject of the relayed video feeds. Perhaps there are things in the universe we should not tangle with.

label.zh: 不管它是不是与神灵有关的媒介，我们都要研究它。
label.en: Conduit for the divine or not, it must be studied.
Let us watch, but not interfere with it.

descriptions.zh: 在[This.System.GetName]恒星系中侦测到的舰队似乎是某种目的不明的跨星系远航舰队的一部分。他们没有采取任何有敌意的举动，也没有任何显而易见的重型武器。然而他们似乎完全缄默不语，我们无法从他们当中获取任何信号。我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]相信他们可以从我们拾获的只言片语中翻译他们的语言，当然这可能要花好长时间。
descriptions.en: The vessels detected in the [This.System.GetName] system seem to be part of some sort of expedition across the galaxy, with purposes unknown. They have not made any hostile moves, nor is there any heavy weaponry in evidence. However, they have been fairly closed-mouthed, and we have been unable to pick up many signals from them. Our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] are confident that they will be able to translate their language eventually from the scraps we pick up. However, this may take quite some time.

descriptions.zh: 我们成功地破解了神秘的§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!语言。我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]被难住了好长时间，直到一次他们开始向我们的大致方向上广播时才取得了突破。广播的内容是一条欢迎讯息，其中他们自称为§H“那马里安”§!。看来他们现在愿意与我们交流了。
descriptions.en: We have managed to decipher the language of the mysterious §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!. Our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] remained stumped for quite some time, and a breakthrough was only made once they began broadcasting what turns out to be a welcome message identifying them as the §H"Namarians"§! in our general direction. It appears that they are now eager to talk to us.

descriptions.zh: 我们在[This.System.GetName]星系遭遇的舰队与我们此前在此区域见到的任何东西都不一样。它没有表现出攻击性，但我们眼下只能猜测它的起源或目的。我们最有把握的猜测是，该舰队代表的派别与任何地方当局或文明都没有正式联系。
descriptions.en: The fleet we encountered in the [This.System.GetName] system is unlike any we've seen in this region of space before. It does not appear to be aggressive, but we can only speculate as to its origin or purpose here. Our best guess is that the fleet represents a faction without formal ties to any local authority or civilization.

options.script:
name = first_contact_critters.100.a
set_first_contact_stage = neutrals_stage_2

descriptions.zh:
我们与这支自称是§H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!的舰队陷入了僵局。这个不寻常的来客对我们大部分的外交姿态置之不理，但我们可以推断它代表一个独立于星系文明的中立实体。

我们推测，若舰队有传统意义上的所有者，则需要采取非常措施才能接近他们。考虑到这一点，我们总结了目前的发现，供未来的[this.owner.GetScientistPlural]团队使用（如有必要）。
descriptions.en:
We have reached an impasse with the fleet identifying itself as the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!. This unusual presence ignored most of our diplomatic overtures, but we can infer that it represents a neutral entity which stands apart from galactic civilization.

We suspect that if the fleet possess any owners in the conventional sense, it would take extraordinary measures to reach them. With this in mind, we have summarized our findings for future teams of [this.owner.GetScientistPlural] to make use of - in case such an opportunity does arise.
